# DuskyMoon Productions

DuskyMoon Productions is an independent record label founded by **Kxrn** (Chitresh), an Indian music producer and software developer. The label focuses on shaping the future of sound through cinematic, forward-thinking music.

## Roster

- **Kxrn** — Founder & Artist. Indian music producer and software developer.
- **Ankit** — Artist. Frequent collaborator, featured on 'Sapne'.
- **Aman** — Artist. Guitarist and musician. Co-artist at DuskyMoon Productions.

## Releases

- **Sapne** (Single) — Released August 2026. A cinematic journey through dreams and reality.
